answer.summary: Spring context fails to load in the API test shard, so every DetectionRemediationApiTest errors before running. Cause is a bean dependency cycle (workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService) that Spring prohibits by default. This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run. The changed file list shows only a test file, so the cycle is most likely from a main-code constructor dependency change on this branch, which the log does not confirm. Also check JsonTypeDirtyOnLoadProbeTest, which fails the same way.
